NFL reverses fine for player's beer-chugging celebration

The NFL has reversed a $15,000 fine issued to San Francisco 49ers player Kyle Juszczyk for pretending to chug a beverage on the field. The league initially deemed the celebration a violation but later stated it is permissible.
